questions: Were all four files modified according to the implementation plan?
Does the --full flag correctly gate the body printing after the TOC?

answers.answer: Yes, all four files were modified exactly as specified: (1) src/library/show.ts — imported hasFlag, renamed _args to args, added conditional body print after the TOC loop. (2) src/library/index.ts — updated help text with [--full] and description. (3) src/index.ts — updated top-level usage line with [--full]. (4) skill-content/references/commands.md — updated code block and added flag table.

answers.answer: Yes. The hasFlag(args, '--full') check at line 67 is placed after the heading-parsing for-loop (lines 45-65), ensuring the TOC always prints first. The body prints only when --full is passed. The existing null guard at lines 28-30 returns early before both the TOC loop and the --full block, so null content is handled safely.
